Telling someone what to do, even if you believe you're trying to help, is actually disrespectful. It strips them of their autonomy and undermines their ability to make mistakes, which is how they learn. If you truly care, you should let them figure it out on their own and only offer advice if they ask. Otherwise, you're just being controlling.
